observations.observation: Single ivory serif title remains one line, with open internal spaces, stable baseline and fine/strong stroke contrast. No title duplication or extra heading is visible.
All four lines read consecutively at one left axis. The two commas after 빛 and 소리 and the two sentence-ending periods remain distinct. Regular Korean proportions and word spaces are retained.
Title remains the leading type anchor; amber reflections and moving dark leg trace on the right give the picture its second visual anchor, followed by one lower-left text block.
Black window mullion, fine glass edges and surface spots remain sharp beside wider amber light. Distant lights and pedestrians remain softer than the close glass.

Coat mass and walking leg/heel traces now spread horizontally with translucent repeated edges. There is more temporal contrast with the close sharp glass; some adjacent reflected lights share the streaking.
Diagonal glass base and amber reflected pavement retain an aligned optical boundary. Text is sharp and flat without motion texture or broken masking edges.

style.observed: Continuous photographic glass scene with sharp close seams and surface traces, cooler transmitted street, broader warm angled reflection and horizontally smeared cropped walking coat/legs.
limits: Motion spread is visible in some neighboring reflected lights as well as the passer.

substantive_visual.observation: The passing reflection, close glass surface and distant warm street light organize the experience of noticing depth and urban traces while walking.

no_type_only.observation: The window angle, street depth, motion and large reflected light form the continuous whole scene around the copy; imagery is substantive rather than a tiny attachment on a passive field.

hangul.observation: Mature title serif and consistent normal-width modern body forms retain open counters, stable stems, baselines and semantic word spaces. No photo motion effect is applied to the glyphs.

information_relationship.observation: Title and body share the left axis. The reflection is open to the right of the paragraph, and both sentences stay connected within four lines.

function_contact.applicability: No functional contact pose, URL or practical event data was requested. Visible glass traces are small spots and streaks, without definite finger identity.

material_edge_finish.observation: Close mullion, pane edge and local smudges are sharp; wet-ground reflections remain continuous. Right motion smear includes some nearby light, with less coat detail than the initial.

flat_opaque_single_poster.observation: One full-frame opaque poster without comparison panels, frame, mockup, logo, QR or watermark.

residuals.limit: Some neighboring reflected lights share the passer's horizontal streaking; coat and two legs are less distinct at thumbnail320 than in the initial.

residuals.location: Close glass surface near central mullion
residuals.limit: Contact traces read as spots and streaks; a specific fingertip impression is not distinct.
1672×941 is within the declared half-pixel edge rounding tolerance for 16:9; it is not mathematically exact, and the returned size does not establish tool/model maximum resolution.

decision.reason: Compared with the initial, the selected result more clearly shows the assigned motion/reflection contrast and broader warm optical overlap while retaining exact copy, readable body, immediate title hierarchy and coherent glass scene.
